requiredBehavior: Environment coordinates concurrent participating session mutations with explicit revision/CAS semantics and complete durable invocation receipts. Reject stale state before avoidable effects where possible; do not replay a completed capability, invent a higher snapshot sequence containing stale state, or overwrite committed snapshots. Store continues to own generic immutable/CAS persistence.
summary: Overlapping entry and selected Store test invocation loaded one snapshot revision. Store correctly rejected different contents under that immutable identity after the invocation had completed; Environment had exposed a raw traceback. Structured diagnostics now preserve the conflict and warn against automatic replay, but convergence and recoverable result receipts remain missing.
title: Concurrent durable session mutations lack snapshot convergence and complete invocation receipts
